title: Claude Code Pricing 2026: Plans, Limits, and Hidden Costs | Superblocks

facts.fact: Claude Code pricing plans range from $0 to $200/month for individuals and from $20 to $125 per seat for teams, according to the page's introduction.
facts.quote: Plans range from $0 to $200/month for individuals and $20 to $125/seat for teams, with weekly usage limits

facts.fact: The Free Claude plan costs $0 and does not include Claude Code.
facts.quote: Casual Claude use (Claude Code not included)

facts.fact: The Pro plan costs $20 per month on a monthly billing plan or $17 per month on an annual plan, which the page says is $200 paid upfront.
facts.quote: At $20/month on a monthly plan or $17/month on an annual plan ($200 upfront)

facts.fact: The Pro plan covers a single user across Claude Code, Claude on web/desktop/mobile, and Claude Cowork under one price.
facts.quote: it covers a single user across all three Claude products.

facts.fact: The Max 5x plan costs $100 per month and provides 5x Pro capacity per five-hour session.
The Max 20x plan costs $200 per month and provides 20x Pro capacity per five-hour session.
Team Standard costs $25 per seat per month, or $20 per seat per month on an annual basis, and is listed for teams of 5 to 150.
Team Premium costs $125 per seat per month, or $100 per seat per month on an annual basis.
Enterprise pricing is listed as $20 per seat plus usage.
Team Standard is listed as best for teams of 5 to 150 people.
Claude Code usage counts against the same limits as Claude chat usage under a subscription.
facts.quote: your Claude Code usage counts against the same limits as your Claude chat usage

facts.fact: Subscription usage limits reset weekly and across five-hour sessions, and the exact token count varies by model selection.
facts.quote: Usage limits reset weekly and across five-hour sessions

facts.fact: Anthropic's Fable 5 access ships in promotional mode on consumer plans prior to June 12, 2026.
The page states that $200/month equals roughly $6.67 per day.
The page claims weekly usage limits can automatically switch a subscription to pay-per-token mode without warning.
facts.quote: weekly usage limits that can automatically switch a subscription to pay-per-token mode
